match.userMessage:
Rough storyboard sketch. CORAL — ONE SHADE, ONE CITY

A wry, kinetic sixty seconds. SCARLETT VEGA, 27, stand-up comic, has a nine-minute set at 9:40pm on the far side of the city. She has one lipstick, no mirror, and forty blocks. The film is not about applying it. It's about whether it survives the night.

. Loose pencil line drawing on white paper, quick gestural strokes, minimal detail. Simple placeholder figures with blank featureless faces, basic shapes for the setting, flat grey marker shading. Monochrome, no colour, no rendering, no realism, no photographic detail. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
